title: Present Perfect: Irregular Past Participles
grammarNote: Present Perfect образуется из have/has + ПРИЧАСТИЕ ПРОШЕДШЕГО ВРЕМЕНИ (past participle). Для правильных глаголов это просто verb + -ed (работает так же, как Past Simple). Но для НЕПРАВИЛЬНЫХ глаголов форма ДРУГАЯ и её нужно заучить. На уровне A2 нужно знать 50-60 самых частых неправильных причастий.

grammarTable.subject: I / You / We / They
grammarTable.example: I've been to Almaty. · They've seen this film before.

grammarTable.subject: He / She / It
grammarTable.example: She's won two championships. · He's built three apps.

grammarTable.subject: Negative
grammarTable.example: I haven't finished the novel. · She hasn't given up.

grammarTable.subject: Question
grammarTable.example: Have you ever been abroad? · Has she won yet?

grammarTable.subject: Short answer (+)
grammarTable.example: "Have you been to Almaty?" — "Yes, I have." (not "Yes, I did.")

rows.example: "She's cut her hair." / "He's cut it three times."
"The team has hit a new record."

grammarExtra.title: Group 2: Vowel change only (i → a → u pattern)

rows.example: "She's gone to Astana." (still there) / "She's been to Astana." (and returned)
"She's given a speech at two conferences."

grammarExtra.title: been vs gone — an important distinction!

rows.form: have BEEN to = visited (and came back)
rows.example: "I've been to Almaty." = I visited Almaty and I'm back now.
"She's gone to Almaty." = She left for Almaty and is still there.
"We've been here for three hours." = we are here, for 3 hours.

rows.form: Test: Is the person still there?

grammarTip:
Лучшая стратегия для неправильных причастий:
① Учи группами: cut/put/hit (без изменений), sing/swim/drink (i→a→u), see/write/give (-en).
② Самые важные: been, done, seen, gone, written, known, given, taken, made.
③ been vs gone — одно из самых частых различий! "I've been to Almaty" (вернулся). "She's gone to Almaty" (ещё там).

💡 Метод: учи тройку: base → past simple → past participle.
→ see → SAW → SEEN. / write → WROTE → WRITTEN.

⚠️ Никогда не используй Past Simple в Present Perfect:
✗ "I have saw" → ✅ "I have seen"
✗ "She has went" → ✅ "She has gone/been"

exercises.hint: "win → won → won" (irregular). "She has won two championships." ✅

exercises.text: I have ___ (see) that documentary three times.
exercises.hint: "see → saw → seen" (irregular). "I have seen that documentary." ✅

exercises.text: "Where's Amir?" — "He's ___ to the lab. He won't be back until 9."
exercises.hint: "gone to" = went and is STILL THERE. He's still at the lab. ✅

exercises.text: She has ___ (write) two research papers this semester.
exercises.hint: "write → wrote → written" (irregular). "She has written two papers." ✅

exercises.text: "Have you ever ___ to Shymkent?" — "Yes, I went there in 2021."
exercises.hint: "have been to" = visited and came back. She was there in 2021 and is back now. ✅

exercises.text: He has ___ (make) three applications from scratch.
exercises.hint: "make → made → made" (irregular: same for past and participle). "has made" ✅

exercises.text: "She has gave a speech at the conference." What is wrong?
exercises.hint: ✅ "She has GIVEN a speech." — "give → gave → given". Never use Past Simple form in PP!

exercises.text: I have ___ (know) him since secondary school.
exercises.hint: "know → knew → known" (irregular). "I have known him since..." ✅

exercises.text: "Have you ___ (do) all the exercises?" — "No, I haven't ___ the last two."
exercises.hint: "do → did → done". In PP: "Have you done...?" / "I haven't done..." Both need "done". ✅

exercises.text: She has ___ (take) this exam twice already.
exercises.hint: "take → took → taken" (irregular). "She has taken this exam twice." ✅

exercises.instruction: Choose the correct past participle of "read".
exercises.hint: "read" stays "read" in ALL forms (base/past/participle), but pronounced /red/ (like "bed") in past.
"sing → sang → SUNG" (irregular: vowel change pattern). "She HAS SUNG at three competitions." ✅

questions.text: Past participle of "go" (when someone has visited and returned):
questions.hint: "have BEEN to" = visited and came back. "I've been to Almaty." ✅

questions.text: Past participle of "go" (when someone is still there):
questions.hint: "have GONE to" = went and is STILL THERE. "She's gone to Almaty." (She's still there.) ✅
"see → saw → seen" (irregular). "Have you SEEN the film?" ✅
"write → wrote → written" (irregular). "She has WRITTEN two papers." ✅

questions.text: "She has ___ (give) three speeches this year." Choose correctly.
questions.hint: "give → gave → given" (irregular). "She has GIVEN three speeches." ✅

questions.text: "He has went to the library" is correct.
questions.hint: ✅ "He has GONE to the library." — "go → went → gone". NEVER "has went"!
"do → did → done" (irregular). "Have you DONE the homework?" ✅
"swim → swam → swum" (i→a→u pattern). "She's SWUM in three oceans." ✅

questions.text: "She ___ (be) to Bishkek and Tashkent." (visited and returned)
questions.hint: "have BEEN to" = visited and came back. "She's been to Bishkek and Tashkent." ✅
"make → made → made" (same for Past Simple and participle). "She has MADE three apps." ✅
"know → knew → known" (irregular). "I've KNOWN her for years." ✅
"take → took → taken" (irregular). "She has TAKEN the exam twice." ✅
"win → won → won". Same form for PS and participle. "She has WON." ✅
"sing → sang → sung" (i→a→u pattern). "She's SUNG at concerts." ✅

questions.text: "He ___ (read) the Aitmatov novel three times." (present perfect)
questions.hint: "read → read → read" (same pronunciation: /red/ for past/participle). "He's READ it." ✅

questions.text: "Amir is ___ to the lab." — He's still there. Which is correct?
questions.hint: "gone to" = went and is STILL THERE. He's at the lab right now. "He's GONE to the lab." ✅
